sentences.en: We've been discussing the factors the architect has to consider when designing domestic buildings.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在讨论建筑师在设计住宅建筑时需要考虑的因素。

sentences.en: I'm going to move on now to consider the design of public buildings, and I'll illustrate this by referring to the new Taylor Concert Hall that's recently been completed here in the city.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我将转向公共建筑的设计，并以最近在本市落成的泰勒音乐厅为例来加以说明。

sentences.en: So, as with a domestic building, when designing a public building, an architect needs to consider the function of the building - for example, is it to be used primarily for entertainment, or for education, or for administration?
sentences.zh: 因此，与住宅建筑一样，在设计公共建筑时，建筑师也需要考虑建筑的功能——例如，它主要是用于娱乐、教育，还是行政用途？

sentences.en: The second thing the architect needs to think about is the context of the building, this includes its physical location, obviously, but it also includes.
sentences.zh: 建筑师需要考虑的第二点是建筑所处的环境，这显然包括其具体的地理位置，但也包括

sentences.en: the social meaning of the building, how it relates to the people it's built for.
sentences.zh: 建筑的社会意义，即它如何与为其而建的民众产生关联。

sentences.en: And finally, for important public buildings, the architect may also be looking for a central symbolic idea on which to base the design, a sort of metaphor for the building and the way in which it is used.
sentences.zh: 最后，对于重要的公共建筑，建筑师还可能寻求一个核心的象征性理念，以此作为设计的基础，即一种体现该建筑及其使用方式的隐喻。

sentences.en: Let's look at the new Taylor Concert Hall in relation to these ideas.
sentences.zh: 让我们结合上述理念，来看一看新建的泰勒音乐厅。

sentences.en: The location chosen was a site in a run-down district that has been ignored in previous redevelopment plans.
sentences.zh: 所选地址位于一个此前城市再开发计划中被忽视的衰败城区。

sentences.en: It was occupied by a factory that had been empty for some years.
sentences.zh: 该地块原先是一座工厂，已空置多年。

sentences.en: The whole area was some distance from the high-rise office blocks of the central business district and shopping centre, but it was only one kilometre from the ring road.
sentences.zh: 整个区域距离中央商务区的高层办公楼群和购物中心较远，但距环城公路仅一公里。

sentences.en: The site itself was bordered to the north by a canal which had once been used by boats bringing in raw materials when the area was used for manufacturing.
sentences.zh: 该地块本身北侧毗邻一条运河，当年该地区尚为制造业基地时，船只曾通过这条运河运入原材料。

sentences.en: The architect chosen for the project was Tom Harrison.
sentences.zh: 该项目选定的建筑师是汤姆·哈里森。

sentences.en: He found the main design challenge was the location of the site in an area that had no neighbouring buildings of any importance.
sentences.zh: 他发现主要的设计挑战在于：该地块位于一个周边没有任何重要建筑的区域。

sentences.en: To reflect the fact that the significance of the building in this quite run-down location was as yet unknown, he decided to create a building centred around the idea of a mystery something whose meaning still has to be discovered.
sentences.zh: 为了体现这座建筑在如此衰败的地点中其重要性尚不明确这一事实，他决定围绕‘谜题’这一理念来设计建筑——即某种意义尚待发掘的事物。

sentences.en: So how was this reflected in the design of the building?
sentences.zh: 那么，这种理念是如何体现在建筑设计中的呢？

sentences.en: Well, Harrison decided to create pedestrian access to the building and to make use of the presence of water on the site.
sentences.zh: 哈里森决定设置步行通道进入建筑，并充分利用场地上的水体元素。

sentences.en: As people approach the entrance, they therefore have to cross over a bridge.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们在接近入口时必须穿过一座桥。

sentences.en: He wanted to give people feeling of suspense as they see the building first from a distance, and then close-up, and the initial impression he wanted to create from the shape of the building as a whole was that of a box.
sentences.zh: 他希望人们在远处初见建筑，继而近距离观察时，能感受到一种悬疑感；而他希望人们从整体外形上对建筑产生的第一印象，是一个盒子。

sentences.en: The first side that people see, the southern wall, iS just a high, flat wall uninterrupted by any windows.
sentences.zh: 人们首先看到的是南侧墙体，这是一面高而平整、没有任何窗户的墙体。

sentences.en: This might sound off-putting, it but it supports Harrison's concept of the building - that the person approaching is intrigued and wonders what will be inside.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能令人却步，但它恰恰支撑了哈里森的建筑理念——即让走近的人感到好奇，并思索内部究竟有何玄机。

sentences.en: And this flat wall also has another purpose.
sentences.zh: 此外，这面平整的墙体还有另一重功能。

sentences.en: At night-time, projectors are switched on and it functions as a huge screen, onto which images are projected.
sentences.zh: 夜间，投影仪开启，墙体便化身为一块巨大的屏幕，用以投射影像。

sentences.en: The auditorium itself seats 1500 people.
sentences.zh: 音乐厅本身可容纳1500人。

sentences.en: The floor's supported by ten massive pads.
sentences.zh: 地板由十个巨大的垫块支撑。

sentences.en: These are constructed from rubber, and so are able to absorb any vibrations from outside and prevent them from affecting the auditorium.
sentences.zh: 这些垫块由橡胶制成，因而能够吸收来自外部的任何震动，并防止其影响音乐厅。

sentences.en: The walls are made of several layers of honey-coloured wood, all sourced from local beech trees.
sentences.zh: 墙壁由多层蜂蜜色木材构成，所有木材均取自当地山毛榉树。

sentences.en: In order to improve the acoustic properties of the auditorium and to amplify the sound, they are not straight, they are curved.
sentences.zh: 为了提升音乐厅的声学性能并增强声音效果，墙壁并非笔直，而是呈弧形。

sentences.en: The acoustics are also adjustable according to the size of orchestra and the type of music being played.
sentences.zh: 音乐厅的声学效果还可根据管弦乐团规模及所演奏音乐类型进行调节。

sentences.en: In order to achieve this, there are nine movable panels in the ceiling above the orchestra which are all individually motorized, and the walls also have curtains which can be opened or closed to change the acoustics.
sentences.zh: 为实现这一点，乐团上方天花板处设有九块可移动面板，每块均配备独立电机驱动；同时，墙壁上还配有可开合的帘幕，用以改变声学效果。

sentences.en: The reaction of the public to the new building has generally been positive.
sentences.zh: 公众对这座新建筑的总体反应较为积极。

sentences.en: However, the evaluation of some critics has been less enthusiastic.
sentences.zh: 然而，部分评论家的评价则不那么热情。

sentences.en: In spite of Harrison's efforts to use local materials, they criticise the style of the design as being international rather than local, and say it doesn't reflect features of the landscape or society for which it is built.
sentences.zh: 尽管哈里森努力采用本地材料，他们仍批评该建筑的设计风格偏向国际范式而非本土特色，认为其未能反映建筑所在地的自然景观或社会特征。
